top_signals.title: Senate Investigates Vance’s Alleged Role in Venezuela Oil Deal
top_signals.summary: The US Senate has launched an investigation into alleged ties between Vice President JD Vance and Vitol regarding an oil-trading contract for Venezuela. The investigation follows a Reuters report from earlier this month, which said the U.S. Vice President had met with a Vitol trader before the U.S. invaded Venezuela. The report, dated November 11, quoted an unnamed source as saying JD Vance had met with a gasoline trader from Vitol named John Addison, whom Reuters described as “an old friend and early financier of his political career”…
